assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready game UI background asset, single portrait panel aspect ratio 4:5. Match the attached references' intricate warm antique pixel-art rendering, walnut wood, brass, amber light. Reference images are STYLE references only, do NOT create a sprite sheet. Orthographic straight-on view, fills canvas edge to edge, narrow outer dark brown backdrop. Thick carved wooden frame at x=0-6% and 94-100%, decorative small leather books and brass reading lamp confined to top 0-12%. A large continuous nearly flat very dark walnut recessed interior occupying x=8-92%, y=16-85%, unobstructed so real UI labels and rows can overlay it. Small elegant brass corner details, fine wood grain, substantial lower wooden ledge at y=90-96%. No shelves or objects crossing the central content region. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI mock data, no buttons, no watermark. The cabinet should feel like the bookshelf reference expanded into an archive UI, with detailed tactile pixel art, not simple geometric blocks.

Rich tactile detailed pixel-art style identical to the reference, crisp pixel edges, warm amber light, no modern vector-flat style. Keep main paper area light cream, provide generous unobstructed space.
